budget.scope_of_count: Base four-step full-generation executions in V2+V3+V5 if no valid reuse; includes candidate/Q1 first-pass production timings, excludes added Dense timing runs/repeats, fits, metrics, downstream evaluation, O40, suffix and shadow costs.

conditional_dense_timing.additional_timing_repeats: Not automatically scheduled; each complete inference counts even without a new encoded video; separately frozen finite scope

budget.profiling: Probe-free production wall time and instrumented component attribution are separate identities; additional profiling inference counts as additional execution.

readout_contract.reason: One DEV source per category provides no within-category resampling variance.
readout_contract.local_primary_aggregation: M(c,e,m): equal mean over prespecified layers of gated SSE/(actual uniform rows*5120). r=(M_m-M_currentQ1)/M_currentQ1. Equal mean of high/low r within source, then equal mean over the 11 DEV sources. Separate six-site and all80 tables.
readout_contract.secondary_aggregation: Preserve absolute risks and ratio of mean risks as secondary tables; do not switch the primary after seeing outcomes.
readout_contract.small_denominator: Use a measurable floor fixed from CAL neutral numerical error; preserve absolute risk, flag relative effect unmeasurable, retain the source and mark affected primary conclusion inconclusive.
readout_contract.timing_aggregation: Per-source log(candidate/currentQ1 production time), then equal source mean; first pass is exploratory, technical replication and interval policy separately frozen.
